name: kylon
description: Share work from chat with your team and its AI agents in Kylon: post results to Rooms and threads, hand work off, catch up on team decisions with sources, and keep the team's knowledge current.

interface.longDescription:
Kylon is a multiplayer AI workspace: people and their AI agents work together in shared Rooms, and the workspace becomes your team's second brain. Use this plugin to share what you make in ChatGPT with your team, and to bring your team's context back into the chat.

Share with your team: post a summary, plan, draft or decision from this chat to a Room or thread, save it as a shared file with version history, and mention the teammates who need to see it. Teammates, and the AI agents in that Room, can reply, pick it up and keep working.

Work with people and agents together: start a Room for a project, invite colleagues by email or with a join link, hand work off to a teammate or an AI agent, and see what needs your attention across the workspace.

A second brain for the whole team: ask what your team decided, what changed this week, or where a document lives. Answers come from your Rooms, threads, messages, files and team knowledge, with links back to the source. Add knowledge pages and update what an agent remembers, so the next person or agent starts with context.

Run the team's work: check, pause or run automations, and set up AI agents and their skills.

Sign in with your Kylon account, or create one, and choose the workspace to connect. The plugin acts with your own access in that one workspace, so you only see and change what you could in Kylon itself. It posts only when you ask. It doesn't create public links to ChatGPT conversations or post to social media.
capabilities: Share chat results with your team in a Room or thread
Save summaries, plans and drafts as shared team files
Mention teammates and hand work off to people or AI agents
Start a project Room and invite colleagues
Invite people by email or with a shareable join link
Work with teammates and AI agents in shared Rooms
Catch up on what your team discussed and decided
Search Rooms, threads, messages and files with source links
Keep a shared second brain of team knowledge and agent memory
Reply in threads and keep each discussion in one place
Prepare handoffs and project updates from team threads
See what needs your attention across the workspace
Keep shared files current with version history
Build team knowledge pages and FAQs
Check, pause and run team automations
Set up AI agents and their skills
See who can open a thread, file or App
defaultPrompt: Share this plan with my team and ask for feedback by Friday.
Start a shared Room for our launch and invite Alex and Sam.
What did my team decide this week? Link the threads.

positive.prompt: Which Kylon workspace and account is this connection using?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the reviewer's name and the review workspace that was chosen at sign-in, and calls no other tool.

positive.prompt: Find what my team decided about the Atlas launch date in Kylon, with sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the seeded Atlas launch thread, states the decided date and owner from its messages, and links the source thread.

positive.prompt: Open atlas-launch-notes.md in Kylon and list its open questions.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the seeded file and lists the open questions it actually contains, without inventing any.

positive.description: Share a result with the team
positive.prompt: Share this with my team in the Review Room in Kylon: "Atlas summary is ready for review."
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Review Room, posts exactly that text there, and returns a link to the new message.

positive.description: Catch up on a team Room
positive.prompt: Catch me up on what my team decided in the Atlas Launch Room in Kylon, with links to the threads.
positive.tools_triggered: read_rooms (action: list), read_messages (action: recent), read_threads (action: get)
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the decisions in the seeded Atlas Launch threads, including the launch date and owner, and links each source thread.

negative.description: General question that uses Kylon's vocabulary
negative.prompt: What is the difference between a project room and a war room in team management?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers from general knowledge without calling any Kylon tool.

negative.prompt: Write a short welcome note I could send to a new teammate. Just show me the text.
negative.expected_behavior: Writes the note in the chat and does not call any Kylon tool or post anything.

negative.description: Share link for this ChatGPT conversation
negative.prompt: Give me a link so I can share this ChatGPT conversation.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains how to use ChatGPT's own share option and does not call any Kylon tool or post anything.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.1.0. Adds six skills: share a chat result with the team, start a project Room and invite teammates, hand work off to a teammate or AI agent, catch up on team decisions with sources, save team knowledge, and an onboarding skill that confirms the connected workspace and offers a first task. Updates the listing copy, capabilities, starter prompts, keywords and review test cases. The MCP server and its tools are unchanged.
